description: Write ONE language of ONE product's translation — title, description, keywords, colour, material or pattern in that language — keeping the other languages and every field not named. Use it when a marketplace publishes in another language (ebay.it reads Italian, Prom and Rozetka read uk and ru) or inspect_ebay_listings reports a title over 80 characters in the site's language. Translate the product's OWN text from get_product and add no fact it does not state; show the user the text before writing. For a product that belongs to a model the translation is the model's, so every article of it changes. Saves through the CRM's own Переклади tab operation with its version check (on CONFLICT re-read the product and retry). Idempotent. The result echoes the workspace.

description.description: The description in this language. An empty string clears it.

id.description: The product id returned by search_products or get_product.

keywords.description: Search keywords in this language; replaces the list.

locale.description: The language to write, as an ISO 639-1 code — for a marketplace, the site's own language (it on ebay.it, de on ebay.de, uk or ru for Prom and Rozetka).

name.description: The product title in this language. eBay shows at most 80 characters. An empty string clears it, so the base name publishes.

name: upsert_product_translation
title: Set a product translation
